test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We need to _____ for next week, so are you in or out?
solution:
The correct answer is __**make plans**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **make plans** means devise a strategy for overcoming obstacles.
 
• The word **make noise** means to make loud sounds
 
• The word **make a mess** means to create a dirty condition
 
• The word** make a mistake** means to do something wrong unintentionally.
 
• The above sentence is in **simple present tense** and the word** "make plans"** completes the above sentence and make the above sentence meaningful and appropriate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Present Perfect Tense

Past Continuous Tense

Past Perfect Tense

 
 
 
Subject + Helping Verb (had) + Past participle of the main verb + the rest of the sentence along with the time frame.

 
 
 

 
 
Past Perfect Continuous Tense

Simple Future Tense

Future Continuous Tense

Future Perfect Tense
